$comment: Canonical image refs the runner uses. Update these to bump versions.

minibob.$note: Pulled from Docker Hub by the deploy chain. Tag 418ba39 includes the MINIBOB_TRANSCRIPT_FILE wiring (Phase 13.1.2) — earlier tags (e.g. e850408) ignore the env var and produce empty transcripts. default_timeout_seconds bumped 300→1200 (Phase 13.1.1) — minibob's improvisation loop needs more wall-clock to make progress on non-trivial prompts.

claudeCode.$note: Anthropic does not publish a public pre-built Claude Code container as of 2026-04. Their devcontainer Dockerfile (https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/.devcontainer/Dockerfile) is dev-machine-shaped (zsh, iptables, dev tools); we instead build a minimal node:20-slim image that npm-installs @anthropic-ai/claude-code. See docs/CLAUDE_CODE_CONTAINER.md.
